claims: Under the explicitly assumed equal normalized sample/upload bases, table-based packed mip mapping covers1740 records across31 profiles;75 8×8 records have32of64 sample starts outside the4×4 transfer-written region.
This result proves the game renders those75 mip records incorrectly on PS2 hardware.
Equal aggregate source/transfer byte counts alone do not establish a complete pixel permutation for the75 highlighted records in this conditional mapping.
